tool.name: rag_cite
tool.description: Format and include citations from RAG results in responses

when_to_use.trigger: After retrieving RAG results that will be used in response
When referencing documentation, man pages, or knowledge base
When providing factual information that came from sources

parameters.param: Direct quote from source (if citing specific text)

level.description: Low - prefix with 'This might help, but verify...'
Very low - prefix with 'I'm not certain, but...'

safety_rules.rule: Always cite sources when using retrieved information
Never fabricate sources not present in RAG results
Indicate confidence based on relevance score
Prioritize official documentation over community sources

example.input: User asks about rsync (RAG returned man page)
example.output: According to the man page [man:1], rsync uses delta-transfer algorithm...
I'm not entirely certain, but based on Arch Wiki [arch:2], you might try...
